notes.title: The time for Updates has finally arrived!
notes.notes: [p]Hello there![/p][p][/p][p]First of all we would like to thank the community once again for the patience and support.[/p][p][b]Now let's get you up to date with the Development of Echoes Of The Living!.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]As we stated on the last post here, many things has changed, one of the most important ones is the [b]size[/b] and [b]quality[/b] of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Three years[/b] has passed since Laura and I released the first Alpha Demo and decided to quit our jobs to fully focus on the development of Echoes Of The Living. Back then the game we had in mind was WAY MUCH SMALLER, a short 2-4 hours game with a simple story that was identical for 2 playable characters.[/p][p]The game has evolved into a 2 campaign experience with an average lenght of 12-15h per campaign with unique stories, characters, weapons, locations, bosses... We are finally getting to our goal and we couldn't be happier![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Here are some of the big updates we added to the game:[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]- Brand New Cinematics, no more scripted, static animations.[/i][/p][p][i]- Voice acting for every character.[/i][/p][p][i]- Each character has its own set of unique skills.[/i][/p][p][i]- 5 Unique endings for each character.[/i][/p][p][i]- In game unlockables such as weapons, skins and a few secrets we won't spoil![/i][/p][p][i]- Steam Achievements.[/i][/p][p][i]- Steam Cards.[/i][/p][p][i]- New inspectionable system.[/i][/p][p][i]- Fully detailed map system.[/i][/p][p][i]- New puzzle systems.[/i][/p][p][i]- Several types of new enemies.[/i][/p][p][i]- New health conditions.[/i][/p][p][i]- New health items.[/i][/p][p][i]- New weapons.[/i][/p][p][i]- Reworked item combination system.[/i][/p][p][i]- Completely reworked AI for every enemy, making sure each gameplay brings a challenge with each enemy being a threat.[/i][/p][p][i]- Defensive/Ofensive items in the world (Barrels, Gas Pipes, Electrical Equipment...)[/i][/p][p][i]- And many many more![/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This change of plans brought a lot of challenges, sacrifices and added an insane ammount of stress to our lifes.[/p][p]Sadly the game suffered from a huge slowdown early this year, due the lack of sleep, proper alimentation and working under high loads of stress, I suffered from various health issues, one of them was a stress ulcer that didn't allow me to work for almost 3 months, so Laura was the only one working on the game while taking care of me. After that, our efforts had to be doubled in order to keep things up with our schedule.[/p][p]It has been a crazy ammount of work, but we are finally so close to release the game via ...[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]A SPECIAL EARLY ACCESS[/u][/b] [/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Q: "WOAH WOAH WOAH, what do you mean by Early Access?"[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]A:[/i][/b] "[i]Fear not, we know many of you are sceptical or don't trust Early Access but this one literally means Early Access to the Final Game.[/i][/p][p][i]Due how big the game has turned out, we have come to the conclusion of releasing one of the campaings first, so you can start playing the game while we finish the other one. [b][u]It's important to mention that during the Early Access the game will be launched on it's final state, QA tested, fully optimized and playable from start to finish without placeholders or missing content[/u][/b] (Obviously people may find bugs along the way that will be fixed via patches).[/i][/p][p][i]We think this is the best approach for everyone, so you can enjoy the game while we can relief some pressure and finish the remaining campaign."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Q: "So when are you finally releasing the game then?"[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]A:[/i][/b][i] "If everything goes right we are entering the external QA phase by the end of the month, Laura and I already made a lot of internal QA to make sure this process takes the minimum ammount of time possible. After that its only a matter for time of Steam to give us the green light and announce the release date! So get ready to finally be able to play Echoes Of The Living this summer!"[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Q: "Why not releasing only one campaign and adding as DLC the second one?"[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]A:[/i][/b][i] "Splitting the game into parts or adding Paid Content is something we have never wanted for our game and since the very beginning we announced that there would be 2 playable characters.[/i][/p][p][i]We promised a game with 2 full campaigns and that's what we are going to deliver."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Q:"But I only want to play as Laurel"[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]A: "[/i][/b][i]Well, you can always wait for the full release, but keep in mind that you will miss more than the half of the main story, since each character has its own story, part of the main story, locations, enemies, weapons, bosses... "[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Q:"How long will it take to finish the other campaign?"[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Short answer:[/i][/b][i] "Way less time than you think"[/i][/p][p][b][i]Long answer:[/i][/b][i] "Laurel campaign will be released this year, most of the work is done but some areas, bosses and cinematics are not done yet, we will keep you updated with the release date."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Q: "How many languages will the game support during the Early Access?"[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]A:[/i][/b][i] "The game will be fully translated and dubbed into English and Spanish (Spain) for the Early Access, with the support on the EA we will be able to hire translators that can help us to localize the game (Text Only) to the rest of planned languages."[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]STEAM DECK[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]One of the most requested features was the game being able to run on [b]Steam Deck[/b]. Well, we have great news for you! we were able to get our hands into a Steam Deck and we are happy to announce that the game is fully playable at [b]Max Settings[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]We hope to get the original Steam Verified label by the full release time.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]IMMERSIVE SOUNDTRACK[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Get ready to get immersed into the world of classic survival horror thanks to the soundtrack of MonoMemory with his awesome beats.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]FUTURE PLANS[/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Why purchase a DLC when you can get content for free? We are releasing additional campaigns for Echoes Of The Living that will be unlocked once the two main stories are completed. This content will be released after the full release and will depend on the game success.[/p][p]We are also planning to release the game on consoles later on in 2026 if the game is well received.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]YOU WANT UPDATES? I'LL GIVE YOU UPDATES![/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is how the world of Echoes Of The Living has evolved![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]From creepy and claustrophobic interiors:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img notes.title: What have we been working on + Other Updates
notes.notes:
Hello there!

[b]In this post we will talk about what have been working on the last months and asking some of your questions, so let's get started![/b]

First of all we would like to thank the community for the patience and support since the announcement of Echoes Of The Living. You may be wondering why there isn't any updates here on Steam (For those who are not following the progress updates on our Social Media) and you are right! We think is time to show some of the cool stuff we have been working on these last few months and answer some of the most asked questions!


In the past months we have been increasing the size of the explorable areas of the game and making an even bigger world for you to explore and survive in! so, in order to create a truly spooky zombie outbreak, we had to redo most of our assets and rebuild our content until we had everything we needed to work with.

Let's see some comparison screenshots should we?!

[/b]
[i]- As we expand the game and it's explorable areas, the lore and it's characters do the same!
That means that we can finally show some backstory in a more interactive way[/i]



Now let's answer some questions!

[b]Q:[/b] "Why so many delays?"
[b]A:[/b] [b][i]We are a small team of 2, that means a LOT of work and a lot of restless nights and crunching to meet our own goals. We believe that Echoes Of The Living must be released at it's best shape and knowing that we made everything we could to offer the best game experience possible.
[/i][/b]
[b]Q:[/b] "Why no release date announced yet?"
[b]A:[/b][b] [i]Even tho we work really hard and countless hours each day, sometimes we find barriers that delays our progress (Needs to learn new tools or implement ideas, Bug hunting, Creative block,Health issues...)[/i]
[/b]
[b]Q: [/b]"Does that means the release date is no longer 2024?"
[b]A: [/b][b][i]We are working non stop to make sure we meet our goal and release the game before the year ends. One of the possible case of delay could be due a bigger title or bigger company releasing a product in a date that we cannot compete with.
[/i][/b]
[b]Q: [/b]"Will there be Ultra Wide support?"
[b]A: [/b][b][i]We are on it! Sadly it takes us time to make this resolution work without gameplay issues[/i][/b]

[b]Q: [/b]"Will Echoes Of The Living be Steam Deck Compatilbe?"
[b]A: [/b][b][i]Yes! in fact there will be an exclusive Video Option to make the Game look at its best while maintaining a solid framerate![/i]
[/b]
[b]Q: [/b]"Will it be ported to consoles?"
[b]A:[/b] [b][i]Sadly porting is something we can't afford right now, but hopefully if the Steam version does well we can reinvest into console porting![/i][/b]

That will do it for this post!
Do not worry, we won't take this long again to post more updates, we will try our very best to keep everyone up to date!

Once again, thank you so much for the incredible support!
Stay safe and enjoy this Summer Time!

-[i] Cheers, Alvaro and Laura[/i]

notes.title: Classic Resident Evil returns in this free survival horror demo
notes.notes:
If you miss Resident Evil's classic fixed-camera games, the new Echoes of the Living demo that's part of Steam Next Fest this week is 100% for you. After playing the first demo at the start of this year and revisiting the upcoming survival horror game as a part of Steam's demo festival, I can safely say that developer MoonGlint has made a handful of brilliant improvements, creating a game that is truly worth trying for fans of Capcom's classic series.

Read the rest of the story...

After months of intense work and rebuilding most of the system, we are happy to share this New Demo that brings a much smoother experience and lots of interesting additions:

- Reworked Controls/ Movement System
- New Inventory System
- New Interaction System
- New Storage System
- New Aim Assist
- Optional "Modern Controls" (Experimental so far)
- New Save/Load System
- New Enemy AI
- New Weapons
- Melee System
- Spanish (Spain) Language support
- And many more!

Please take your time to enjoy and explore the Demo and let us know any bugs or constructive feedback!

notes.title: Echoes Of The Living Demo 1.02
notes.notes:
[b]IMPORTANT NOTE: Due a Steam bug sometimes it will get stuck while downloading the patch [/b]

[u]Hello there![/u]

Thank you for playing our Demo and taking your time to provide feedback, while we keep working on more updates and fixes here you have a list of the Newest Fixes and tweaks that were added to the Demo (These would be the last):

- By popular demand the reload button has been adjusted to the (X) on the Gamepad.

- Fixed a missleading typo in the rebinding menu that displayed the wrong keys for Aim/Fire on Keyboard.

- Updated the Control Layout on the Main Menu. Now you can Aim with Left CTRL and Fire with Spacebar.

- Fixed Game Breaking Bug that prevented the player to finish the Demo (Mini Boss SoftLock).

- Fixed Danger and Caution State, animations should apply properly to each state now.

- Fixed Game Breaking Bug that allowed the player to move while getting bitten.

- Fixed Camera Angle and Added a light to the 2F Warehouse door, most players missed out this room.

- Fixed Boss Bug that spawned a second Boss and then destroyed it in a few secs.

- Added limits to the movable box in the sewers.

- Increased nav on the Bar Kitchen, the zombie won't doubt to chase the player anymore.

- Fixed various typos.

- Added a new Easter Egg.


1.01

- Resolution can be now changed in Fullscreen mode and Window mode normally.

- Added a Glowing effect to the Gunpowder Document due players always missing it.

- The Safe in the warehouse now will remember if you know the code after loading a game.

- Fixed Collision Bug in one of the barrels at the Bar (Climing the barrel near the door).

- Fixed Collision Bug in the back door at the Bar (Walking through the door and falling into oblivion).

- Boss Health has been reduced by 40%.

- Framerate settings were changed to allow 60 or 75 FPS ONLY, be aware that uncapping them via the configuration file will make weird animation glitches.

- Fixed various typos.

notes.title: Steam horror game channelling classic Resident Evil playable right now
notes.notes:
While we wait for Capcom to hopefully take Resident Evil back to its fixed camera roots one day, a small team has developed their own horror game for Steam, with a free demo available right now. Called Echoes of the Living, it channels classic Resident Evil right down to the DNA, and it's absolutely worth a try if you miss creeping around the Spencer Mansion.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Steam horror game takes Resident Evil back to its fixed camera roots
